reviews.title: Not happy with this apps storage
reviews.text:
I had this app for a while now and at first it seemed great, but I became very reliant on this app and used it to scan and keep a lot of important documents and pictures and it’s library and storage. I even paid a lot of extra money to upgrade the storage for no reason apparently because for some reason every time I try to locate documents that should be there there either unable to be found or they just won’t load and it’s happening to almost every single video and a lot of pictures. Recently, I decided to take everything and try and put it on an external hard drive so it’s safe and stored properly, but of course I can’t even access the majority of the documents that I want because they were either saved incorrectly or this app is just not functioning incorrectly and not allowing me to retrieve my data. 
Not to mention the app crashes quite a lot, especially during syncing or if it’s I guess working too hard. 
I should have just paid the extra money for Apple iCloud storage or some other company because I can’t tell you how upsetting it is to spend all this extra money on extra storage and all the while, relying heavily on this app to keep these important and unretrievable documents and long lost videos that I’ll never be able to get back so if you have important stuff that you don’t want to be lost forever, I wouldn’t use this app

reviews.title: Started trial, tested and cancelled
reviews.text:
As an artist frequently on the move, this app with features advertised would potentially provide a superior scanning experience than the iOS native scanner built in to Notes. It does not. 

I installed the trial and as a test, scanned two drawings from a sketchbook where the pages don’t lay completely flat. I also deliberately used slightly sub optimal lighting to see how the app would deal with shadows. The short answer is, it doesn’t deal with them very well. Colour accuracy on the Clear setting is pretty good but the slight shadows on the curvature of the page next to the spine did not clear at all. 

Even less satisfactory, the supposedly AI Dewarp (I forget the actual name of it but you get the idea) made the slight curvature of the page far worse and had to be undone. 

I am always suspicious of apps that attempt to inveigle the user into a subscription immediately upon initial launch, as is the case here. 

I immediately cancelled my trial and deleted the app. 

My advice, save your money and use the free scanner already available in the Notes app. Find the flattest light available, smooth down the page and if necessary, tweak the corners the crop before saving to Photos. It’s free and gets the job done.
